searchText: So the geth we're running (mariusvanderwijden-ssz-engine-api, commit 85445ac, the latest published) advertises SSZ for amsterdam only. Earlier forks aren't in supported_forks, so consensoor has nothing to negotiate for fulu and stays on JSON-RPC there — exactly as observed. I'm trying to test the branch but only seems to support amsterdam, but amsterdam is not properly implemented yet in geth Lol sorry, will fix Fixed, the routes were implemented, just not advertised yeah just had a same problem while interoping. My current local setup starts from Fusaka you now stopped advertising ams? lol yes, because its not done in that branch ok will test fulu and pre fulu only then ``` INFO[2026-06-16T10:43:30Z] RESPONSE #16: [h2c] POST /engine/v2/osaka/forkchoice → engine_forkchoiceUpdated[osaka] duration_ms=0 length=47 status=400 type=json { "type": "/engine-api/errors/unsupported-fork" } ``` ``` When he added earlier-fork support, he updated three things but forgot a fourth: - ✅ capabilities.go — now advertises ["paris","shanghai","cancun","prague","osaka"] - ✅ forkmap.go (ForkFor) — maps all of paris→amsterdam correctly - ✅ bodies.go — resolveFork(w, fork, forks.Paris) ← correctly lowered to Paris - ❌ forkchoice.go, payloads.go, get_payload.go — still resolveFork(w, fork, forks.Amsterdam) ``` your claude is running out of credits ? or trying to hand code like a caveman? `This is a textbook half-landed WIP PR` 😂 claude ain't happy :( the prysm branch seems to be hidden behind a flag ? You should use this flag: --engine-ssz-http for beacon node yup testing with that already there seems to be some more issues with geth than I initially thought
